title: Megurine Luka — School SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Luka.
Would this be a good time for a chat?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, Honami.
Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What would you like to talk to me about?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... I was hoping to get your advice about something.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Go on then, ask me anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You see, I...don't feel like I can cope with performing in front of an audience.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why not? You've been doing so well in your rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you but...
It's not about my technique.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've just begun to think that maybe drums aren't my thing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honami, why don't we sit down? This is a very important matter to you, so we should make ourselves comfortable and take our time talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, why do you think drums aren't for you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I learned to play percussion instruments when I joined the school's brass band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why it seemed natural that I should become the drummer in our band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But in this kind of band, the role of the drummer is much more important than what I was used to from the brass band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I set the rhythm for the entire band.
Everyone depends on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I...don't have the confidence to play such an important role.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Tell me, Honami, do you dislike playing drums?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no, I have nothing against drums per se.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's good.
And did anyone in the band complain about your drumming?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, no one's said anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought so.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But then there's no reason for you to think drums aren't the right instrument for you, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't you agree, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right, of course...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki told me that my drumming's easy to follow, and even Shiho said it's good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I can play drums fairly well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... Sometimes I get anxious thinking that maybe I shouldn't be the one to do this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I just wanted to tell somebody about these doubts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
It really wasn't worth mentioning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I'm glad you told me about this. Everyone loses confidence sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But, Honami, you should remember...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're surrounded by friends who believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In those moments when you stop believing in yourself, think about them, and trust their judgement.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They believe in me even when I don't...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My doubts won't disappear so easily, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do my best to keep playing as best I can for my friends who rely on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Keep enjoying what you do!
